OPT-UOA1.why: call VOLUME history exists (Alpaca daily option bars carry each contract's volume), but OPEN INTEREST history does not: Alpaca's contract list gives only the latest open interest, Alpha Vantage HISTORICAL_OPTIONS (volume + open interest per day) is a premium endpoint the free key cannot call, and the free HISTORICAL_VOLUME_OPEN_INTEREST_RATIO gives only a per-contract ratio (the open interest of contracts that did not trade cannot be recovered) at 25 calls a day. Unlock: an Alpha Vantage premium plan key in ALPHAVANTAGE_KEY (HISTORICAL_OPTIONS gives each contract's daily volume and open interest); the rule then runs as registered.
